en: I cleaned the vegetables in the kitchen.
I didn't clean my room yesterday.
Did you clean the fish today?
Why didn't you clean your car?
You cleaned the lentils well.
You didn't clean the garden this morning.
He cleaned the floor from garbage.
He didn't clean the well from stones.
She cleaned the fruits for the children.
My sister didn't clean the table well.
We cleaned the rooftop in the evening.
We didn't clean the almonds for the pastry.
Did you clean the big house?
You didn't clean the kitchen yesterday.
They cleaned their street.
The workers didn't clean the shop well.
I clean potatoes every day.

lat: ma kanneqqish l-bit dyali f l-lil
en: I don't clean my room at night.
You clean the well every year.
Why don't you clean your room?
You always clean the vegetables early.
You don't clean the rice now.
My father cleans the car in the morning.
He doesn't clean the ram well.
My mother cleans the peas every night.
She doesn't clean her window.
We clean the garden every morning.
We don't clean the rooftop in winter.
You clean the kitchen every day.
You don't clean the floor well.
The children clean the school today.
They don't always clean the street.

lat: ghadi nneqqi l-kuzina ghedda f s-sba7
en: I am going to clean the kitchen tomorrow morning.
I am not going to clean the car today.
Are you going to clean your room?

lat: nta ma ghadish tneqqi l-ard daba
ar: نتا ما غاديش تنقي الارض دابا
en: You are not going to clean the floor now.

lat: nti ghadi tneqqi l-khodra l l-3sha
en: You are going to clean the vegetables for dinner.

lat: nti ma ghadish tneqqi s-ste7 l-yum
ar: نتي ما غاديش تنقي السطح اليوم
en: You are not going to clean the rooftop today.
He is going to clean the garden tomorrow.

lat: khuya ma ghadish yneqqi t-tabla l-lila
ar: خويا ما غاديش ينقي الطابلة الليلة
en: My brother is not going to clean the table tonight.

lat: hiya ghadi tneqqi l-3des l l-ghda
en: She is going to clean the lentils for lunch.

lat: khti ma ghadish tneqqi l-bit dyalha
ar: ختي ما غاديش تنقي البيت ديالها
en: My sister is not going to clean her room.
We are going to clean the school tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish nneqqiw l-ma7all had l-lila
ar: ما غاديش ننقيو المحل هاد الليلة
en: We are not going to clean the shop tonight.
Are you going to clean the house?

lat: ntuma ma ghadish tneqqiw l-jnan l-yum
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تنقيو الجنان اليوم
en: You are not going to clean the garden today.
They are going to clean the street well.

lat: l-wlad ma ghadish yneqqiw l-bit daba
ar: الولاد ما غاديش ينقيو البيت دابا
en: The boys are not going to clean the room now.
